## Professional Overview
Mayank Raj Gupta is a full-stack developer and AI systems engineer recognized for architecting end-to-end production web applications, multimodal deep learning models, and privacy-preserving clinical platforms. He combines rigorous software engineering principles (Data Structures, OOP, distributed state management, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility) with cutting-edge artificial intelligence (Whisper ASR, Mistral-7B, U2-Net, YOLOv11, PyTorch, and Vis-NIR spectroscopy).

## Flagship Projects & Technical Highlights

### 1. Praxirence — Ambient Clinical Intelligence Platform
- **Timeline:** September 2026 – Present
- **Domain:** Healthcare AI & Ambient Documentation
- **Architecture:** Dual-ecosystem native Android mobile applications (Doctor App & Patient App) with FastAPI and Python 3.11 backend.
- **AI/ML Pipeline:** Fine-tuned Whisper-Small with LoRA (FP16) for real-time consultation transcription; fine-tuned Mistral-7B with QLoRA generating structured SOAP notes (0.92 ROUGE-1).
- **Security & Privacy:** DPDP Act 2023 & HIPAA compliance, in-memory audio shredding (zero voice audio retention), blind HMAC-SHA256 indexing, AES-256-GCM data encryption.
- **Web Demo:** https://www.praxirence.com
- **Case Study:** https://www.mayankraj.me/case-study/praxirence

### 2. Confidential Agricultural Vision & Spectral Analytics System
- **Timeline:** June 2026 – Present
- **Affiliation:** Christ (Deemed to be University) — Stipend-Funded Research Grant
- **Domain:** Computer Vision & Multimodal Authentication
- **Pipeline:** Automated 4-stage computer vision curation engine synchronizing 400nm–1000nm Vis-NIR diffuse reflectance spectroscopy with visual specimen morphology across 2,300 physical samples (11,500 multimodal artifacts).
- **Deep Learning:** U2-Net nested ReS-UNet neural segmentation with continuous floating-point alpha mattes (<120ms/image), anti-aliased Lanczos-3 sinc-windowed downsampling, Porter-Duff Over compositing.
- **Case Study:** https://www.mayankraj.me/case-study/agricultural-vision-spectral-analytics

### 3. Wholesale & Retail E-Commerce Platform (Roshan Enterprises)
- **Domain:** High-Throughput E-Commerce & Inventory Logistics
- **Tech Stack:** React 19, Vite, Firebase Auth & Realtime Database, Vanilla CSS, list virtualization via react-window for 60fps scrolling across high-volume SKU catalogs.
- **Features:** Dual retail/wholesale buying workflows, role-based pricing matrices, zero cumulative layout shift (CLS), WCAG 2.1 AA compliant.
- **Live Demo:** https://e-commerce-roshan-enterprises-dhn.web.app
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/M20A03/E-commerce-Online-Shopping-for-Retail-and-Wholesale
- **Case Study:** https://www.mayankraj.me/case-study/roshan-enterprises
